Preview endpoints for welcome, help_request_received, booking_confirmed, and password_reset all render clean HTML: logo pinned to nearby-connect-93.emergent.host/api/email-assets/orrbbit-logo.png, privacy/terms use https://orrbbit.com (APP_URL), NO preview.emergentagent or localhost anywhere, friendly 'Open this securely in your browser.' fallback present on CTA emails and correctly ABSENT on password_reset (no CTA). Prod endpoints live: logo asset 200 image/png (~50KB), /api/email/verify?token=bad and /api/email/unsubscribe?token=bad both 200 with branded Orrbbit HTML over HTTPS. critical_code_review_comments: email_templates.env_cfg() correctly prefers .env FILE via dotenv_values over os.environ — this is the right pattern for platform-injected APP_URL override, verified working end-to-end.

email_service.py line 55: from_addr composed from env_cfg('FROM_NAME'), env_cfg('FROM_EMAIL') — Resend API returned exactly the configured 'ORRBBIT <notifications@updates.orrbbit.com>', confirming the env_cfg wiring is applied at service init.
prefs_url now uses PUBLIC_BASE_URL/email-preferences (email_service.py:153) — consistent with backend-served URL pattern; APP_URL reserved for orrbbit.com marketing links only. Correct.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Cutover fix is verified on the preview backend. Prod deployment at nearby-connect-93.emergent.host still runs the OLD code until owner redeploys — do NOT trigger prod email sends, only the static/HTML endpoints listed here. Live send caps: max 2 per run, only to delivered@resend.dev, NEVER to k97davies@icloud.com. Do not print RESEND_API_KEY, TEST_MODE_CODE, or qa-admin password.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: platform injects APP_URL=<preview host> into process env; python-dotenv's load_dotenv() by design does NOT override existing env vars, so backend/.env's APP_URL=https://orrbbit.com was silently ignored → emails contained preview URLs. Fix: email_templates.env_cfg() uses dotenv_values(...) to read the .env FILE directly and prefers file values over os.environ for APP_URL/SUPPORT_EMAIL/PUBLIC_BASE_URL/EMAIL_LOGO_URL/FROM_NAME/FROM_EMAIL/RESEND_API_KEY. Verified: rendered HTML now has orrbbit.com in APP_URL positions and emergent.host in logo/unsub positions, no preview URLs anywhere, and Resend API confirms the live delivered message matches.
